purpose: Coverage-level (CLM_CVG_PK), day-grid-cutoff embedding snapshot datasets for Attorney/Litigation/Severity. Built directly from raw per-note embeddings (not the date-deduped running-feature store), one row per (CLM_CVG_PK, snapshot).
ported_from: 3.1-Dataset-Development.ipynb (boundary/margin-rule/day-grid logic; NOTE_TEXT replaced with embedding aggregates)
margin_rule: strict '<' on boundary; if no note lands exactly on the boundary, drop ONLY the single latest still-included note (by note_id seq order) if its own text matched an event keyword; earlier same-date notes are never affected
dedup_rule: day-grid snapshot skipped if its eligible note count is unchanged from the previous surviving snapshot, or if it would have 0 eligible notes
label_col: label (int8): ATTNY_FLG/LITIG_FLG (0/1) for Attorney/Litigation; SEV_BUCKET (0-4) for Severity

variations.name: mean
variations.formula: elementwise mean of the eligible notes' embeddings as of this cutoff

variations.name: max
variations.formula: elementwise max of the eligible notes' embeddings as of this cutoff

variations.name: min
variations.formula: elementwise min of the eligible notes' embeddings as of this cutoff

variations.name: sum
variations.formula: elementwise sum of the eligible notes' embeddings as of this cutoff

variations.name: max_div_min
variations.formula: elementwise max / min (safe-divide eps=1e-06, clipped to +-65504)

variations.name: first_div_last
variations.formula: elementwise first / last (safe-divide eps=1e-06, clipped to +-65504)

split_rule: global claim-level stratified 70/15/15 (see _SPLITS.json); split is encoded by the {model}/{split}/ folder, not a column
